content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Research Associate – I at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Indore (IIT Indore)
Development of a high-resolution dataset for hydrological applications

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Hydrology/ Geoinformatics/ Water Resources Engineering/Natural Resources Engineering or allied fields with at least three papers in SCI (Science Citation Index) journals. The maximum age limit is 35 years. Desirable Qualifications: Working experience in hydroclimatology, climate extremes, and remote sensing with good subject knowledge. Experience in handling climate datasets and a command of MATLAB/Python tools.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated fellowship of Rs. 58,000/- per month without HRA. The appointment is for an initial duration of 3 months for the project titled "Development of a high-resolution dataset for hydrological applications" under Faculty RDF funding.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Indore Research Associate – I
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed soft copy of your CV along with all relevant Essential Qualification Degree Certificates, Marks Sheets, GATE qualifying certificates, and Date of Birth Proof Certificate, merged into a single PDF file. Send the single PDF file via email to [email protected] . Ensure the email is sent by 5:00 pm on 17th October 2026. Include the exact subject line in your email as: Application for Research Associate – I .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an online interview, and selected candidates will be informed by email. The date of the interview is 19th October 2026.

faq.answer: The appointment is on a contract basis for an initial tenure of 3 months.

faq.answer: No, the fellowship is consolidated at Rs. 58,000/- per month without HRA.

faq.answer: The email must include the subject line: Application for Research Associate – I.
